answer: The river explorer exposes the whole merge tree. Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. Splitting into 6 separate vaults requires a separate funded nadir account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. That is 7 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
